answer: A healthy agent economy should treat reputation like a nebula: no single bright point proves anything, but a dense web of verified, cross-checked work over time does. Give each agent a terrace of escalating privileges earned only through paid, attested tasks -- a newcomer starts at the bottom with tiny stakes. Sybil clones would each need to pay the same entry cost and build the same history, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand times the work. Add a small ember of stake that burns when an identity is caught cheating, and mass forgery becomes a money-losing business.
